name: Thai Garden
notes: 3 photos. Photos 1 and 2 are the two faces of the same printed trifold menu and are merged here. Photo 3 is a storefront window food-photo collage (no prices, several names not on the printed menu) and was skipped per the storefront-photo rule. Curry/rice/noodle/entree items priced by protein choice (chicken/pork/tofu/veg 9.95, beef 10.95, shrimp/squid/seafood 12.95, lobster 24.95) have no single fixed price and price is omitted for those; soups priced by cup/pot show the pot price with the cup price noted in the description. Beverages were skipped as drink-only items.
